head: Spotify comes to United Airlines seatback screens with Starlink
dek: United Airlines is rolling out a Spotify app on its seatback screens, where you sign in to your own account and stream your playlists and podcasts in flight over Starlink Wi-Fi.
details: Starlink Wi-Fi is being installed across United's fleet, which makes live streaming possible instead of music stored on the plane.
where: United Airlines flights with Starlink Wi-Fi, rolling out
means: If you fly United, your own Spotify library can play on the seat screen.
todo: Have your Spotify login handy for your next United flight.
